708e832df4edb470.description: About the Role Maaden is seeking a Principal Specialist Data Modeling & Arch (Operational Technology) to establish the data modeling and architecture foundation for Operational Technology (OT) and industrial data across its plants, sites, and operational systems in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for enabling trusted OT analytics by standardizing data representation, governance, and alignment with enterprise IT data products. Key Responsibilities Define enterprise OT data modeling standards for time-series data, events, alarms, assets, tags, measurements, and production contexts. Establish canonical OT concepts, including asset hierarchy, location hierarchy, tag naming, measurement definitions, and work order linkage. Design scalable data schemas for curated OT layers and reusable OT data products with auditability, lineage, and quality attributes. Architect OT-to-IT data alignment patterns that connect operational measurements with enterprise entities for reporting and analytics. Define integration rules for tag mapping, unit standardization, reference data, semantic consistency, and cross-site normalization. Embed governance-by-design into OT data models, including ownership, metadata, lineage, quality rules, and lifecycle controls. Define quality attributes for historian data, including compression, interpolation, quality flags, sampling frequency, and streaming patterns. Partner with OT engineering, cybersecurity, data platform, and infrastructure teams to design secure and compliant OT data flows. Review solution designs, data models, vendor deliverables, and integration approaches to ensure architectural consistency. Provide technical leadership on OT semantics, industrial data architecture, data modeling practices, and data product design. Coach engineers, data modelers, platform teams, and solution teams on OT modeling standards and implementation practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in data modeling and architecture, specifically within Operational Technology (OT) or industrial data environments. Demonstrated ability to define and implement enterprise OT data modeling standards for various data types. Experience in designing scalable data schemas and ensuring modeling patterns address high-volume industrial data and site variability. Proficiency in aligning historians, SCADA/DCS, condition monitoring, maintenance, reliability, and production data with enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data governance principles and their application to OT data models, including metadata, lineage, and quality rules. Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity requirements and designing secure OT data flows. Expected Outcomes Standard OT data models are defined and consistently adopted across sites, platforms, and industrial systems. Assets, tags, events, alarms, measurements, and production contexts are represented consistently for trusted analytics. OT-to-IT integration patterns enable reliable cross-domain reporting, performance analysis, and data product development. Curated OT layers include clear lineage, quality rules, auditability, and governance controls. Site onboarding, tag normalization, unit standardization, and data model reuse are accelerated through practical reference patterns. Technical Leadership and Mentorship The Principal Specialist will provide technical leadership in OT semantics and industrial data architecture. This includes coaching engineers and platform teams on modeling standards, leading design reviews for critical OT data initiatives, and building knowledge assets to accelerate consistent OT data architecture delivery. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be disclosed during the recruitment stages.

Jumeirah aims to provide distinctive experiences for guests worldwide. About Jumeirah Jabal Omar, Makkah Jumeirah Jabal Omar Makkah is located in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, minutes from Masjid Al Haram. The hotel features four towers, dining venues, retail outlets, a gym, an executive lounge, and meeting spaces. It offers views of the Grand Mosque and a culinary selection including Mediterranean, Persian, Middle Eastern, and Southeast Asian cuisines. The Role: Learning & Development Administrator An opportunity has arisen for a Learning & Development Administrator to join the team at Jumeirah Jabal Omar. This full-time role involves coordinating and supporting various learning and development activities within the hotel, ensuring adherence to Jumeirah standards. Key Responsibilities Coordinate training programs, workshops, orientations, and learning activities, including scheduling, invitations, attendance tracking, and preparation of training materials. Maintain accurate Learning & Development records, training databases, attendance sheets, and colleague training history. Monitor mandatory training completion and follow up with departments and colleagues to ensure timely compliance. Support the preparation and implementation of monthly and annual training calendars. Conduct and support training sessions and learning activities for colleagues in line with Jumeirah standards and departmental requirements. Assist with new colleague orientation, onboarding programs, cross-training, cross-exposure, and other development initiatives. Prepare Learning & Development reports, presentations, training statistics, and related documentation as required. Coordinate with internal trainers, external providers, and departments to ensure smooth delivery of Learning & Development activities. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate for this position will possess relevant experience and qualifications in a similar administrative or learning and development support role. Specific experience requirements were not provided. Compensation and Benefits Jumeirah offers an attractive salary, paid in Saudi Riyals (SAR). Benefits include generous food and beverage discounts, reduced hotel rates across Jumeirah properties globally, comprehensive leave and health care packages, flights home, and other employee benefits.

703eee25df6e60d8.job_title: Lead Account Manager Catalyst & Absorbents (Saudi National Only)
703eee25df6e60d8.description: About the Role Honeywell Technologies is seeking a Lead Account Manager for Catalyst & Adsorbents. This full-time position is based in Dhahran and involves driving growth within the UOP Process Technology Refining & Petrochemical (R&P) business. The role requires a commercially driven and technically strong individual to manage key refining, petrochemical, and gas processing customers in KSA. Role Context and Objectives The Lead Account Manager will hold full account ownership, focusing on strategic account development, revenue growth, and fostering long-term customer partnerships. This position operates at the intersection of commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders, managing opportunities from early engagement through to contract closure and execution within the Catalyst, Adsorbents, and Specialty Products portfolio. Key Responsibilities Execute strategic account plans for major customers in KSA, aligning with regional and global growth objectives. Drive revenue, margin, and market share growth across catalyst and adsorbent product lines, including reload cycles, performance upgrades, and new unit opportunities. Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including operations, technical teams, procurement, and executive leadership. Identify, qualify, and mature opportunities through a value-based sales approach, particularly in turnaround (TAR) and project-driven environments. Lead commercial negotiations and contract structuring, ensuring alignment with profitability targets and risk management guidelines. Maintain accurate sales forecasts (12–18 months) and pipeline visibility in SFDC. Collaborate with technical services, R&D, and engineering teams to position differentiated solutions. Engage with licensors, EPC contractors, and consultants to influence specifications and secure early positioning in new projects. Monitor market dynamics, competitor positioning, and pricing trends. Support working capital management, including payment terms, collections, and contract compliance. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 8-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated commercial drive and technical strength in the catalyst, adsorbents, or specialty products sector. Experience in strategic account development and managing long-term customer partnerships. Proficiency in commercial negotiations and contract structuring. Ability to manage sales forecasts and pipeline visibility. About Honeywell Technologies Honeywell Technologies is a global automation company focused on solving mission-critical challenges and enhancing quality of life. The company serves the building, industrial, and process sectors with a portfolio of services, solutions, and products, supported by its Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. With over 50,000 employees and decades of data, Honeywell Technologies aims to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy. Application Information Salary details for this position are not disclosed. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

706d9dd22b8ac0a2.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث نزل عبدالوهاب بن سعيد الزهراني للنزل السياحيه عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الباحة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على توفير تجربة استقبال ممتازة للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة الاتصالات الهاتفية، وتنظيم السجلات الإدارية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمبتدئين في هذا المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء والترحيب بهم، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إعلام المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى القسم المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب مواعيد المقابلات وتسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للعمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية ولباقة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهيًا وكتابيًا. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة الوقت بفعالية. القدرة على التعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية والاستفسارات بكفاءة. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة. القدرة على حفظ السجلات وتحديثها بدقة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الباحة. يتوقع من موظف الاستقبال العمل ضمن فريق داعم لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

708b6635a103c8bd.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking a Nursing Supervisor to lead the nursing team in the Riyadh Region. This full-time role involves overseeing daily nursing and personal care for clinic patients, ensuring adherence to individual needs and capabilities. The Nursing Supervisor is responsible for providing comprehensive medical and nursing care, offering advice and emotional support to patients and their families, and managing administrative tasks. Key Responsibilities Lead the nursing team during assigned shifts, ensuring high standards of patient care. Provide medical and nursing care, including advice and emotional support to patients and their families. Ensure strict adherence to infection control and hygiene guidelines and codes. Manage stock levels and readiness of medical equipment and consumable materials in clinics. Disinfect clinical surfaces and equipment at the start of the day and after each patient. Greet patients, take and document medical history, and screen for risks such as falls, nutritional deficiency, and functional impairment. Triage patients in the emergency room to categorize their emergency status. Perform minor wound dressings and monitor patients under observation. Prepare and administer intramuscular and intravenous medications under aseptic conditions. Escort patients in ambulances and assist physicians with examinations and procedures. Withdraw blood from patients for laboratory investigations in the emergency room. Supervisory Duties Orient newly recruited nurses to the organization's policies and procedures. Ensure the daily availability of the required nursing workforce. Collaborate with the medical director to maintain and enhance the quality of patient care. Supervise the work performance of registered nurses. Conduct annual appraisals for nursing staff. Serve as a member of the community advisory committee. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in nursing. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a nursing team effectively. Strong understanding and application of infection control and hygiene guidelines. Proficiency in medical and nursing care procedures. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Nahdi Medical Co. clinic environment. The role requires active participation in patient care and team supervision. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

708f1c4ad47c24eb.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن مدير صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في محايل، عسير. يتولى مدير الصيانة مسؤولية وضع خطط صيانة المرافق والمعدات وتوجيهها وتنسيقها، بالإضافة إلى إدارة العمليات اليومية لضمان تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة بكفاءة وتقليل زمن التعطل عن العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير استراتيجيات وإجراءات شاملة لأعمال الصيانة في المصنع. التخطيط لأعمال الصيانة الوقائية وعمليات التفتيش ومباشرة تنفيذها. التنسيق مع قسم الإنتاج فيما يتعلق بالتصليحات اللازمة. مباشرة أنشطة التخطيط والأنشطة اليومية لموظفي الصيانة. ضمان تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة دون تأخير لتقليل وقت التعطل عن العمل. الفحص الدوري للمعدات المهمة في المصنع. معالجة المشاكل الهندسية والتشغيلية قصيرة وطويلة الأجل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم. مراقبة أداء وسلوك الموظفين مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. وضع السياسات والإجراءات لضمان الالتزام بقوانين ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ومباشرة تنفيذها. البقاء على اطلاع دائم باتجاهات القطاع وأفضل الممارسات. تحديد مبادرات تهدف إلى التحسين المستمر للعمليات التشغيلية وتنفيذها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو إدارة المرافق. فهم عميق لعمليات الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية. القدرة على إدارة الفرق وتوجيهها بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في محايل، عسير، وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لإدارة عمليات الصيانة والإشراف على الفرق. يعمل مدير الصيانة ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التنسيق المستمر مع أقسام الإنتاج والالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة. نوع الوظيفة دوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

70a07e1c45cf3a76.description: About the Role eXtra is seeking a Sales Consultant to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time position is central to supporting the store's overall success by ensuring customer satisfaction, contributing to sales performance, and enhancing profitability. The role focuses on delivering a consistent shopping experience that aligns with company standards. Role Overview The Sales Consultant plays a key part in the daily operations of the store, directly impacting customer engagement and sales targets. This position requires a proactive approach to customer interaction and adherence to established operational guidelines to maintain high standards across all store functions. Key Responsibilities Focus on customer needs and provide excellent service. Drive sales of products and services offered by the store. Maintain visual merchandising standards to enhance product presentation. Ensure adherence to safety and security protocols within the store environment. Assist with inventory management tasks to ensure accurate stock levels. Engage in continuous self-development to improve skills and performance. The role involves direct interaction with customers and collaboration with store colleagues to achieve collective goals. 70c0b1dd50fc67cf.description: About the Role Green Earth is seeking a Purchase Specialist to manage the end-to-end procurement cycle, vendor relations, and provide key financial and administrative support. This full-time role is based in Makkah, specifically covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah, and requires 0-1 years of experience. The specialist will ensure optimal inventory levels, manage shipping logistics, process accounts payable, and maintain accurate financial and utility records. Key Responsibilities Manage the entire procurement cycle, from processing internal purchase requests to issuing official Purchase Orders (POs). Identify, vet, and negotiate with local and international suppliers to secure optimal terms on price, quality, and delivery. Oversee general inventory (GE), monitor stock levels, anticipate future needs, and place orders proactively to prevent shortages, especially for items with long lead times. Maintain and update current item costs in a shared Excel file to ensure budget transparency. Coordinate all logistics and shipping activities, liaise with freight forwarders, and manage shipping documentation. Ensure compliance with customs clearance procedures, including SABER certification and the handling of dangerous goods where applicable. Book air and bus tickets as instructed by relevant parties. Collect vendor invoices, record them in Zoho, and perform monthly or quarterly reconciliations of vendor statements. Process payments from the petty cash bank account, review petty cash expenses against submitted invoices, and assist the accountant with data entry during peak workloads (*, VAT, Zakat, audit months). Update the monthly utilities bill tracking file, inform management of upcoming due dates, and process payments promptly to prevent service suspensions. Maintain accurate records and reporting for all procurement, logistics, and supplier payment requests. Qualifications and Requirements Proven experience as a Procurement Officer, Inventory Controller, or in a similar administrative/finance support role. Proficiency with Zoho and advanced Excel skills, including managing trackers, cost sheets, and utility logs. Familiarity with local and international shipping, customs clearance, and compliance procedures such as SABER certification. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, from petty cash reconciliation to vendor negotiations. Commitment to Inclusion Green Earth is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe that innovation and operational excellence are enhanced by diverse perspectives. Our aim is to create an accessible and barrier-free workplace where individuals with disabilities are valued and empowered. Why Disability Inclusion Matters Driving Innovation: Diverse perspectives enhance problem-solving capabilities, leading to improved engineering solutions and superior client service. Unlocking Top Talent: Attracting and retaining talented professionals from all backgrounds and abilities ensures access to the best minds in the industry. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply.

70d9a67e6f41a207.description: About the Tamheer Program and Role This role is for a Key Account Specialist within GE HealthCare Saudi Arabia, located in Dammam, Eastern Region. It is offered as part of the Tamheer Program, a six-month on-the-job training initiative designed to develop fresh graduates and prepare them for future career opportunities. This is an internship position. Role Overview The Key Account Specialist is a customer-facing role responsible for supporting sales and account management activities. The position focuses on maintaining and growing relationships with assigned accounts, ensuring customer satisfaction, and contributing to business objectives. The role operates within established processes and guidelines, with some autonomy in decision-making. Key Responsibilities Support sales activities for assigned accounts; addition of new customers is rare and subject to review. Assist in managing key accounts within the business group/P&L. Develop working knowledge of GE HealthCare products, solutions, and customer needs. Collaborate with the senior commercial team to execute strategies and achieve targets. Understand key business drivers and contribute to team objectives. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure seamless delivery and customer satisfaction. Ensure customer satisfaction from understanding customer unmet needs to project execution oversight. Provide accurate documentation, reporting, and updates on account activities. Communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders; explain technical and commercial information clearly. Qualifications and Experience This role requires 0-1 years of experience, making it suitable for fresh graduates. Candidates should be eligible for the Tamheer Program. Work Type and Location This is an internship position based in Dammam, Eastern Region, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a customer-facing environment as part of the GE HealthCare team. Application Information The salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

70ed3663687bb300.description: About CEER Motors and the Role CEER Motors is establishing Saudi Arabia's first homegrown electric vehicle brand. We are seeking an Additive Manufacturing Senior Specialist to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position includes a full relocation package and is critical for shaping the prototyping and manufacturing processes for the next generation of vehicles within our Machining Centre. Role Overview The Additive Manufacturing Senior Specialist will be responsible for operating and maintaining composite and metal (Aluminum) 3D printing systems. This role supports prototype part manufacturing and advanced research projects, focusing on developing and implementing process controls to ensure quality. The specialist will also contribute to material development, optimization, and project planning. Key Responsibilities Operate metal and composite 3D printers using various technologies as part of the Additive Manufacturing team. Prepare, slice, and optimize build files utilizing CAD and slicing software, with a preference for Siemens NX and 3DXpert. Monitor and control all aspects of machine operation. Conduct part inspection, calibration, and post-processing, including depowdering and heat treatment. Perform routine maintenance, cleaning, and troubleshooting of equipment. Collaborate with process engineers and other teams to enhance print strategies, build orientation, and support generation. Optimize process parameters to improve efficiency and quality. Ensure safety and quality compliance in accordance with ATEX standards. Manage material inventory and support material selection and development based on internal customer requirements. Manage turnkey jobs and projects, working with internal customers to plan, develop, and deliver work that meets their specifications. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience operating industrial metal 3D printers. Demonstrated experience in additive manufacturing, including design for additive manufacturing. Strong working knowledge of CAD/CAM software, ideally Siemens NX. Experience with build preparation and slicing software. Experience handling metal powders and performing post-processing operations. Experience with electromechanical systems, including drives, actuators, and motion control. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be collaborative, communicate clearly, take initiative, and drive for results while maintaining high standards. Adaptability in fast-moving environments and a customer-first approach are essential for success in this role. Compensation and Benefits CEER Motors offers a competitive, tax-free salary and an annual performance bonus. The comprehensive benefits package includes a full relocation package, competitive annual leave, housing allowance, private medical cover for the employee and their family, education allowance for children, and visa and residency sponsorship.

70231a3d2be677cf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أول الخليج للمشاريع عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المهندس المعماري في هذا الدور مسؤولية تصميم المباني الجديدة أو الإضافات والتعديلات على المباني القائمة. كما يقدم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها، ويساعد في اختيار المواقع ويشرف على أعمال الإنشاءات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير فكرة المشروع وتحويل متطلبات العميل إلى تصميم عملي وجمالي. إعداد المخططات باستخدام برامج التصميم المعماري مثل AutoCAD وRevit وSketchUp وغيرها. إعداد الواجهات والقطاعات والتفاصيل المعمارية. اختيار وتنسيق مواد التشطيب والألوان والعناصر المعمارية. التنسيق الفعال مع المهندسين الإنشائيين والكهرباء والميكانيكا لضمان التكامل. مراجعة المخططات والتأكد من توافقها مع كود البناء والاشتراطات المحلية والدولية. إعداد النماذج ثلاثية الأبعاد والـ Renderings لعرض التصميم على العملاء وأصحاب المصلحة. المشاركة في اجتماعات العميل ومناقشة التعديلات والبدائل التصميمية. متابعة تنفيذ التصميم في الموقع والتأكد من مطابقته للمخططات، وذلك حسب نطاق العمل المحدد. إعداد جداول الكميات أو المواصفات المعمارية عند الحاجة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على استخدام برامج التصميم المعماري مثل AutoCAD وRevit وSketchUp. فهم جيد لكود البناء والاشتراطات الفنية. نوع العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في الرياض. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة أول الخليج للمشاريع، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

70aa6c0579ef8e59.description: About the Role Pico Play is seeking a Procurement Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing the end-to-end procurement process, from sourcing materials and managing supplier relationships to coordinating with local teams and clients. The Procurement Engineer will ensure efficient and cost-effective procurement to meet project needs, while also facilitating communication between local clients in Saudi Arabia and the Pico Play tender team in KL. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with project and organizational goals. Oversee the complete procurement process, including tendering, negotiations, vendor selection, and contract management. Evaluate and qualify suppliers to ensure compliance with quality, cost, and delivery requirements. Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and stakeholders to identify material and service needs. Analyze market trends to source optimal products, services, and suppliers. Ensure timely delivery of materials and services to meet project schedules. Manage procurement budgets, ensuring cost-effectiveness and accountability. Monitor supplier performance and address any issues related to delivery, quality, or service. Prepare and maintain detailed procurement records and reports for audits and reviews. Implement and enforce procurement policies and procedures. Foster relationships with key suppliers to ensure long-term partnerships. Client and Tender Coordination Serve as the primary contact point between local clients in Saudi Arabia and the Pico Play tender team in KL. Ensure direct communication between local clients and the Procurement Engineer, bypassing the KL team for initial contact. Understand tender requirements and identify appropriate suppliers and subcontractors for quotation gathering. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in procurement engineering or a similar role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring coordination with both local teams and international counterparts.

70ade07a44cd1c0b.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Consultant Internal Medicine & Adult Endocrinology to provide comprehensive medical care to adult patients. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on delivering expert clinical care in telemedicine settings for internal medicine and endocrinology needs. The role involves diagnosing, treating, and managing a wide range of endocrine conditions, including diabetes, thyroid disorders, adrenal diseases, and metabolic syndromes. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive assessments and accurate diagnoses of endocrine disorders, including detailed patient histories and physical examinations. Utilize diagnostic tools such as blood tests, imaging studies (ultrasound, MRI), and other endocrine function tests, collaborating with laboratory staff for interpretation. Perform comprehensive telehealth consultations for internal and general medicine complaints, developing personalized treatment plans and prescribing medications. Oversee ongoing care for chronic and acute conditions, adjusting treatment plans based on patient feedback and clinical outcomes. Practice population health management by identifying and addressing community health issues, implementing preventive measures, and promoting health education. Ensure the delivery of high-quality and safe clinical care, adhering to established clinical guidelines and best practices. Foster effective collaboration with multidisciplinary healthcare teams, engaging in regular case discussions and facilitating referrals. Maintain compliance with all patient safety standards, reporting any risks or issues to the appropriate quality department staff. Document findings and treatment plans meticulously in patient records. Treatment Planning and Implementation Develop and implement effective treatment plans, discussing options and preferences with patients. Design individualized treatment strategies that may include medication, surgery, or non-invasive therapies. Monitor patient progress and adjust treatment plans as necessary. Explain medications, possible side effects, and proper use to patients. Clinical Quality and Patient Safety Adhere to clinical guidelines and best practices established by professional organizations in endocrinology. Participate in quality assurance initiatives, including audits and peer reviews. Implement safety protocols to minimize risks and complications associated with endocrine treatments. Maintain satisfactory patient consultations through effective communication, thorough history taking, empathy, and clear explanation of diagnosis and management plans. Professional Development and Compliance Commit to ongoing professional development, participating in continuing medical education (CME) activities, workshops, and conferences. Stay updated on advancements in endocrinology practices and technologies. Ensure compliance with health regulations and institutional policies. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. 7084669d74e5a55c.description: Job Title: Manager, Procurement & Supply Chain (Healthcare Experience Required) Department: Procurement & Supply Chain Management The Manager of Procurement & Supply Chain owns vendor and contract risk for QHC from Day-1 and builds the procurement and supply-chain capability the organization needs as it scales through the startup phase. The role ensures that sourcing, contracting and supplier management are governed, compliant and value-driven. The role establishes the policies, processes and controls that let QHC procure at pace without compromising governance. The role works across clinical, technology, facilities and enabling functions, and coordinates with QIC shared services and third-party providers, to ensure the reliable, cost-effective and compliant supply of medical and non-medical goods and services. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. Procurement Strategy & Planning • Develop and maintain QHC's procurement plan aligned with startup priorities, activation milestones and budget, including category strategies for medical, technology, facilities and professional services. • Forecast demand and lead times and sequence sourcing activity to meet Day-1 and scale-up needs. • Advise leadership on make-versus-buy and leverage-from-QIC decisions across categories. 2. Sourcing, Tendering & Contract Management • Lead sourcing, tendering and competitive evaluation processes with fairness, transparency and auditability. • Negotiate and structure contracts, service agreements and framework arrangements that protect QHC commercially and operationally. • Maintain the contract register, manage renewals and expiries, and ensure obligations are tracked and met. 3. Vendor & Supplier Relationship Management • Establish and manage supplier relationships, onboarding, qualification and performance monitoring against agreed KPIs and SLAs. • Own vendor risk — including concentration, continuity and compliance risk — and drive remediation where performance falls short. • Build a reliable supplier base for critical medical and operational categories. 4. Supply Chain & Inventory Management • Establish supply-chain and inventory processes across medical consumables, pharmaceuticals, equipment and non-medical supplies. • Ensure availability, traceability and appropriate stock levels for clinical and operational continuity, minimizing waste and stock-outs. • Coordinate logistics, warehousing and distribution arrangements as required. 5. Governance, Compliance & Risk • Implement procurement policies, delegation of authority, controls and segregation of duties to mitigate financial and compliance risk. • Ensure compliance with Saudi procurement and regulatory requirements and with QIC service and governance frameworks. • Maintain audit readiness, procurement records and risk registers for internal and external review. 6. Cost Optimization & Value Delivery • Drive cost efficiency, value-for-money and total-cost-of-ownership discipline across procurement decisions. • Identify and deliver savings, consolidation and demand-management opportunities without compromising quality or continuity. • Provide procurement input to budgeting, business cases and capital planning. 7. Systems, Process & Capability • Support the implementation and use of e-procurement and supply-chain systems and dashboards. • Standardize procurement processes and build internal capability as the function grows. • Provide clear procurement reporting and analytics to Finance and leadership. EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field is required. A professional certification (CIPS, CPSM, or equivalent) and / or a Master's degree is preferred. 6+ years of progressive experience in procurement and supply-chain management, including sourcing, tendering, contract negotiation and vendor management, ideally within healthcare, construction / facilities, or large project / startup environments. Demonstrated experience owning vendor and contract risk and establishing procurement processes and controls. Experience with medical / pharmaceutical supply chains and with accredited healthcare environments is an advantage. Working knowledge of Saudi procurement and regulatory requirements and of operating within shared-services or SLA-based models. Strong commercial, negotiation and analytical capability.

7088638d634b7cfd.description: About REPLIL and the Role REPLIL develops cybersecurity and infrastructure management solutions for industrial and operational technology (OT) environments. The company's flagship platform, REPLIL Industrial Patch Manager (IPM), provides centralized patch and vulnerability management across diverse industrial settings. This platform assists organizations in identifying, assessing, approving, deploying, and monitoring operating system, software, firmware, and vendor-approved updates across IT and OT infrastructure. We are seeking a System Engineer with expertise in infrastructure, networking, troubleshooting, and patch management to join our team in Khobar, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of experience. Role Overview The System Engineer will be responsible for the deployment, configuration, support, and troubleshooting of REPLIL Industrial Patch Manager and its supporting infrastructure within customer environments in Saudi Arabia. This is a hands-on technical role suitable for an engineer proficient with Windows Server, patch management technologies, networking, firewalls, remote management protocols, and enterprise infrastructure. While experience in OT or industrial environments is advantageous, candidates with a strong IT infrastructure and patch management background who are interested in developing OT expertise are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Deploy, configure, administer, and troubleshoot REPLIL Industrial Patch Manager (IPM) and related components. Manage and troubleshoot Windows Server environments. Configure and support Microsoft patch management technologies, including WSUS, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), and Windows Update. Understand the complete patch management lifecycle, from discovery and synchronization to deployment, verification, and reporting. Troubleshoot failed patch installations using Windows and application logs. Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity between distributed systems, including firewalls, switches, routers, VLANs, ports, routing, DNS, and certificates. Troubleshoot remote management technologies and protocols such as WinRM/PowerShell Remoting, WMI, SSH, SNMP, HTTPS/TLS, and RDP. Monitor system availability, performance, services, logs, and infrastructure health. Support patching and management of Windows, Linux, applications, and network infrastructure. Assist customers and internal teams with technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. Prepare technical documentation, deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides, and customer reports. Participate in system design reviews, testing, SAT activities, implementation, and customer handover. Required Qualifications 3+ years of hands-on experience in System Engineering, System Administration, Infrastructure Support, or a similar role. Practical understanding of enterprise patch management. Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server administration. Experience with WSUS, SCCM/MECM, Windows Update, or comparable enterprise patch management platforms. Good understanding of Windows patching, servicing, cumulative updates, security updates, prerequisites, reboot requirements, and patch failure troubleshooting. Working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, certificates, services, Task Scheduler, and PowerShell. Good understanding of TCP/IP networking, ports, routing, VLANs, DNS, and firewall rules. Hands-on experience troubleshooting firewalls and network equipment. Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to systematically diagnose infrastructure, operating system, application, and network issues. Ability to communicate technical issues clearly with customers and internal engineering teams. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Experience and Career Growth Experience in OT/ICS/Industrial Control Systems, IT/OT network architecture and segmentation, industrial cybersecurity, Linux administration and patching, or vulnerability management will be considered an advantage. Previous OT experience is preferred but not mandatory. This role offers significant hands-on learning opportunities for engineers interested in progressing from traditional System Administration/Infrastructure Engineering into OT/ICS Infrastructure and Cybersecurity. You will be trained to work with critical infrastructure and OT environments, gaining practical exposure through the REPLIL R&D environment to technologies from multiple enterprise and industrial vendors, including Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft, Industrial PLCs, and various OT/ICS systems. Candidate Profile We are particularly interested in engineers who demonstrate strong hands-on troubleshooting ability and a willingness to learn. Candidates should be able to address practical scenarios such as diagnosing Windows patch failures, understanding patch applicability, troubleshooting remote communication issues (*, WinRM), identifying required firewall ports, and safely deploying patches across production systems. The ability to distinguish between network, authentication, operating system, application, or patch-related problems is essential, especially in isolated or restricted network environments.
